en.summary: CoinW's ANT Launch Plan rewards people who hold an ANTUSDT perpetual futures position worth at least 100 USDT in notional value, funded with their own money, for full 60-minute periods, until Nov 30, 2026, 23:59:59 (UTC+8). It's open to users who register for the campaign and meet its eligibility and regional rules, and one person can get up to 1,200 USDT in Mega Coupons from a shared 12,000 USDT pool.
steps: Open the campaign page on CoinW and register for the campaign. The rules say to do this first.

Using your own funds (not bonuses), open an ANTUSDT perpetual futures position with a notional value of at least 100 USDT. Notional value is the full size of the position: your margin times your leverage.
Keep that position open for a full qualifying 60-minute period. Only full hours count. Don't hedge it: holding a long and a short at the same time doesn't count.
Do it before the campaign ends: Nov 30, 2026, 23:59:59 (UTC+8), which is 15:59:59 UTC.

payout.when: The available text doesn't say when rewards are settled or credited, or whether there's a deadline to claim them. Check the full official rules on the campaign page.
payout.form: Mega Coupons: up to 1,200 USDT per person, from a total pool of 12,000 USDT in Mega Coupons. Your amount is calculated at a campaign rate “equivalent to 1,200% simple annualized”. That's only the formula for sizing the coupon, not an investment return. The rules don't say whether a Mega Coupon can be withdrawn or what it can be used for, so check that on the exchange before you count on cash. If the pool limit is hit, the actual payout may be lower.
payout.how: The text doesn't say where the coupon shows up or whether you have to claim it manually. Look for it in your CoinW account after settlement, and check the full rules.

watch: Bonuses and hedged positions don't count. Only a one-direction position funded with your own money qualifies.
Only full hours count. An incomplete hour doesn't qualify.
The pool is shared: 12,000 USDT in Mega Coupons. If many people join, the actual payout may be reduced.

The rules say it plainly: futures trading can result in substantial losses. A sharp move in ANT's price can liquidate your position, meaning the exchange closes it by force and you lose the margin. The coupon doesn't cover those losses.
The 1,200% figure is not an investment return. It's only the rate used to calculate campaign rewards.
Eligibility, limits and regional rules apply. The announcement doesn't name any countries, so check that the campaign is available where you live.
This is based on a short announcement. The full rules may contain more conditions.

faq.q: Do I need 100 USDT of my own money?
faq.a: The 100 USDT is the notional size of the position, so leverage is included. The announcement doesn't give a minimum margin. Only your own funds count, not bonuses. The higher the leverage, the closer you are to liquidation.

It's the rate CoinW uses to work out your coupon for the time your position qualifies. It's scaled to a full year, without compounding. It doesn't promise you any profit, and your position can lose far more than the coupon is worth. The exact formula isn't in the announcement.

faq.q: Can I hold a long and a short at the same time to avoid risk?

faq.a: The start date isn't stated. It ends Nov 30, 2026, 23:59:59 (UTC+8), which is 15:59:59 UTC.

faq.q: What happens if the pool runs out?
faq.a: The total pool is 12,000 USDT in Mega Coupons. If pool limits apply, your actual payout may be lower than the calculated amount.

faq.q: Can I withdraw the Mega Coupon?
faq.a: The rules don't say. Before you count on cash, check on CoinW what a Mega Coupon is and how you can use it.
